name: building-wordpress-blog
description: Opinionated, batteries-included spec for adding an SEO-first, i18n-ready blog to a WordPress site (block, classic or page-builder themes; Yoast SEO or Rank Math; Polylang or WPML). Walks 46 intake questions, scans the site, drafts a one-page plan for approval, then implements against an 18-section spec with a pass/fail checklist. Ships a tested site plugin (Blog Kit) and an AI hero-image generator that uploads Gemini images to the media library.
